What to have ready before you book

The more precise your request, the more useful the appointment. For maintenance: describe the symptom in three parts — when it happens (cold start, a certain speed, turning), what you notice (sound, vibration, smell, a message on the display), and when it started. A short video of the noise saves the technician half the journey. For painting & bodywork: clear daylight photos — the whole panel from a step back, the damage straight-on and at an angle — are enough for an initial assessment before any visit.

Add the VIN if convenient — found at the base of the windscreen or in the registration card — as it lets the workshop prepare the exact parts and procedures for your specific model before you arrive. And remember the request commits you to nothing: assessment first, then scope and price for your approval, then the work.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is the form submission a confirmed booking?

No — it is an appointment request. The workshop team reviews your details and contacts you to confirm the date and time. For same-day needs, calling is the fastest route.

What happens to the photos I upload?

They are used by the workshop team to assess your case and for nothing else. Vehicle photos are never published or shared without your documented consent — see the privacy policy.

I don't know which service to choose in the form.

Choose the closest match and describe the symptoms in the message field — the team maps your description to the right service. The workshop choice (maintenance vs painting) is the one that matters most.
